/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request,re,uuid
url='http://localhost:3100/'
html=urllib.request.urlopen(url).read().decode()
action=re.search(r'\\"'$ACTION_ID_([a-f0-9]+)'"',html).group(0)
boundary='----post-test-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
fields=[(action,''),('title','Fresh post check'),('body','Created through the Server Action')]
body=''.join(f'--{boundary}\\r\\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"{name}\"\\r\\n\\r\\n{value}\\r\\n' for name,value in fields)+f'--{boundary}--\\r\\n'
request=urllib.request.Request(url,data=body.encode(),headers={'Content-Type':f'multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}'},method='POST')
response=urllib.request.urlopen(request)
print('submit status:',response.status)
print('submit includes post:', 'Fresh post check' in response.read().decode())
html=urllib.request.urlopen(url).read().decode()
print('next load includes post:', 'Fresh post check' in html)
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request,re,uuid,pathlib
url='http://localhost:3100/'
assert not pathlib.Path('data/posts.json').exists()
html=urllib.request.urlopen(url).read().decode()
assert 'No posts yet.' in html
action=re.search(r'\\"'$ACTION_ID_([a-f0-9]+)'"',html).group(0)
boundary='----post-test-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
fields=[(action,''),('title','Fresh post check'),('body','Created through the Server Action')]
body=''.join(f'--{boundary}\\r\\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"{name}\"\\r\\n\\r\\n{value}\\r\\n' for name,value in fields)+f'--{boundary}--\\r\\n'
request=urllib.request.Request(url,data=body.encode(),headers={'Content-Type':f'multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}','Origin':url[:-1]},method='POST')
response=urllib.request.urlopen(request)
assert response.status == 200
assert 'Fresh post check' in response.read().decode()
assert 'Fresh post check' in urllib.request.urlopen(url).read().decode()
assert pathlib.Path('data/posts.json').exists()
print('passed: clean store, submit response, and next page load')
PY"
